source: ILT_Day1_Sheet_A4_35x25_Dimensions.pdf (final sheet from the research team, 2026-10-26; supersedes the 34 x 25 corrected sheet and the scanned measurement)
origin: top-left corner of the grid (centre of the top-left frame line); x to the right, y downward
measurement_note: Distances to dot centres and frame-line centres. Dot positions approximate; dot outer diameter ~2.6 mm.

letter.shape: '>' as printed: A top, B to the right, C bottom (Hebrew). English mirroring is a per-language setting, default not mirrored.

width_rule.definition: cumulative horizontal travel while writing the letter (out to B, back to C)

fill_order.he: right to left, starting at the top-right box (box order per row: col 5 to col 1)
fill_order.en: left to right, starting at the top-left box (box order per row: col 1 to col 5)
